Name: Superbia Bloodline: Lou 1
Description:
Lou's blood code. Its balanced stats make it suitable for a wide variety of fighting styles.

Has high Mind.

Features traits geared toward both offense and defense, such as enhancing attack power on a successful drain attack, potentially inflicting the slow status ailment, and enhancing guard.

The Superbia Bloodline originated with the great hero Idris and consists of prominent revenants with considerable influence over the frontier.

It has produced a great many revenants with balanced abilities who are blessed with strong bodies and powerful forma abilities.

While Lou is somewhat frail, she possesses the power to interfere with time, a rarity even within the Superbia Bloodline. This blood code embodies the unique traits of her power.

Name: Superbia Bloodline: Noah 1
Description:
Noah's blood code. Works well with a technical fighting style.

Has high Dexterity and Fortitude.

It requires finesse, but if mastered, it is capable of taking out streams of foes in short order.

Noah became a revenant at the behest of Voda House. He offered his life for the sake of his human family, an act made all the more selfless due to the fact that his turning was no guaranteed success.

This blood code demonstrates Noah's extraordinary physical ability and exceptional talent for battle.

Name: Superbia Bloodline: Valentin 1
Description:
Valentin's blood code. Its high-level stats and max ichor allow for a variety of strategies.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower.

Capable of further extending its already high attributes and overwhelming foes with successive forma attacks.

Even among the Superbia Bloodline, houses which trace their lineage directly to Progenitor Idris tend to produce revenants of exceptional power.

Hierarchy in revenant society is complex, with relatives consisting of both those born directly to parents of the bloodline and those who were turned into revenants by someone of the same bloodline. As such, the heads of the families are typically selected on a system of meritocracy.

Next in line to head Voda House, Valentin is a man both wise and bold, seemingly capable of anything he sets his mind to. The extensive range of his prowess is evident in his blood code.

Name: Gula Bloodline: Josée 1
Description:
Josée's blood code. Excellent performance in close combat and ichor recovery.

Has high Strength, Mind, and Vitality.

Its trait protects against ichor depletion, allowing aggressive forma use. However, caution is advised, as excessive ichor absorption can inflict bodily harm.

Revenants of the Gula Bloodline possess massive levels of energy. As their bloodline name suggests, many are voracious eaters, but most have surprisingly small physiques as well. Many compensate for their small stature with honed swordsmanship or other combat abilities, developing their own unique techniques.

Josée herself trained in the sword styles of the Far East from a young age, combining her martial abilities with those of her bloodline. These abilities shine through the traits of her blood code.

Name: Gula Bloodline: Josée (Blind)
Description:
Josée's blood code. Has high stats and a unique trait specialized for close combat.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, and Fortitude.

Allows the user to absorb ichor when hitting foes with formae, enabling otherwise impossible strategies. However, it also increases the ichor cost of formae, so caution is advised.

The desperate impulsiveness which led Josée to gouge out her own eyes in her darkest moment has had a significant impact on this blood code's traits.

Name: Gula Bloodline: Lise 1
Description:
Lise's blood code. Excellent at forma use and combat staying power.

Has high Dexterity, Mind, and Vitality.

Restores LP when foes are defeated, improving staying power on long expeditions and against large groups. However, there is a danger of taking damage when out of stamina, so caution is advised.

Lise is Josée's biological twin. Calm and rational by nature, her abilities are better suited for support roles than for being directly in the line of combat. However, she has honed her fighting skills, driven by the belief that she can only offer support if she can first hold her own on the battlefield.

Her desire to be self-reliant is evident in the traits of her blood code.

Name: Patientia Bloodline: Lyle 1
Description:
Lyle's blood code. Enhances technical fighting styles.

Has especially high Dexterity.

Grants benefits for parrying and dodging, enabling a fighting style focused on skillfully dealing with enemy attacks and unleashing powerful counters.

The Dawn Chorus was organized by revenants of the Patientia Bloodline. Though the entire bloodline are natural warriors, the Chorus consists of the most martially skilled among them.

The greatest swordsman even among his talented companions, Lyle uses his slender physique to fight with precision and speed. Such traits are apparent in his blood code.

Name: Patientia Bloodline: Lyle (Artificial Arm)
Description:
Lyle's blood code. It features unique traits and a heavy emphasis on certain stats.

Has especially high Strength.

In addition to its base trait of enhancing counterattacks against foes, this blood code also allows the user to bring on the pressure by quickly swinging two-handed swords.

Pent-up feelings of resentment and hostility from a naturally gifted swordsman who lost it all are apparent in this blood code.

Name: Patientia Bloodline: Craig 1
Description:
Craig's blood code. Geared toward withstanding enemy attacks on the front lines.

Has high Strength, Vitality, and Fortitude.

This blood code rewards guarding, enhancing the user's attack power even when hit. This allows the user to use head-to-head strategies to force their enemies to surrender.

Craig was born not only into the Patientia Bloodline, one of the minor bloodlines, but also into one of the minor houses within it. McLeish House are the descendants of executioner Gregory McLeish. After the Resurgence changed the world, the house gained influence on the frontier through Craig's mother Imogen's pioneering developments.

Many of the revenants of McLeish House are blessed with incredible physiques, and Craig is no exception. Built strong and possessing the courage to stand up for his convictions, he excelled in hand-to-hand combat. His blood code likewise offers similar strengths.

Name: Luxuria Bloodline: Holly 1
Description:
Holly's blood code. Its increased Willpower and max ichor make it well-suited for using magic formae.

Has especially high Willpower.

Allows the user to consume their own HP to activate formae when out of ichor, balancing the risk with the opportunity for intense firepower. It also restores HP when foes are defeated, granting high staying power.

The Luxuria Bloodline possesses rare healing abilities. Their incredible power to heal the immortal comes at a cost, however. Inflicting a disease that behaves much like the Resurgence. As such, their numbers are few.

Though her bloodline is naturally adept with formae, Holly herself had a difficult time achieving her potential when she was young. The fact she became one of the most distinguished forma researchers on the frontier speaks volumes about her incredible determination and dedication.

The abilities of her blood code show a first-hand glimpse of this unwavering willpower.

Name: Luxuria Bloodline: Holly (Condemned)
Description:
Holly's blood code. Possesses increased Willpower and a special means of absorbing ichor.

Has especially high Willpower.

Ichor-absorbing abilities allow for absorption on successful dodges, enabling strategies that rely on a quick rotation of formae.

This blood code is characterized by the deep, consuming regret Holly felt for her own misdoings, and the fixation on ichor absorption likely stems from her desire to bring back all those slain by her very own hands.

Name: Luxuria Bloodline: Lycoris 1
Description:
Lycoris's blood code. Enhances summoned partners.
 
Has high Dexterity and Willpower.
 
This trait increases your summoned partner's attack power to help you take down enemies more easily if you coordinate well.

Name: Luxuria Bloodline: Lycoris 2
Description:
Lycoris's blood code. Enhances summoned partners.
 
Has high Dexterity and Willpower.

Name: Luxuria Bloodline: Camilo
Description:
Camilo's blood code. Excels at offense and support, and possesses a unique means of ichor recovery.

Has high Strength, Mind, and Vitality.

Possesses a unique trait that enables the recovery of ichor without using drain attacks, allowing the use of formae which wouldn't normally be possible.

Name: Acedia Bloodline: Zenon 1
Description:
Zenon's blood code. Features high-level stats and distinctive traits.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, and Vitality.

Allows the substitution of burden between stats, enabling a wide variety of weapon configuration builds. Also features unique effects that trigger during clear weather or while LP is depleted.

Many of the Acedia Bloodline are both individualistic and tend towards intellectual endeavors. As such, the bonds between its members are fractured and superficial. Despite this, the seemingly unmatched potential of each individual has garnered the bloodline considerable influence.

Yet even among such company, Zenon is a revenant of unique and outstanding character.

A man of such diverse talent, even his blood code captures only a fraction of his immeasurable traits.

Name: Patientia Bloodline: Iris 1
Description:
Iris's blood code. Its specialty is crushing foes with brute strength.

Has high Strength and Vitality.

Uses its innately high Strength to increase balance and force foes to the ground.

The Patientia Bloodline is one which branched off from the Ira Bloodline. The prosperity of the Ira granted the Patientia Bloodline great numbers, many of whom excelled in combat and were in turn made combatants for the cardinal houses.

Iris was born beyond the frontier, in a region where the Ira Bloodline rules and the gap between the cardinal and minor houses sees many break away in search of new lands.

Perhaps due to the severe conditions she was born into, Iris shares little regarding her origins.

Name: Superbia Bloodline: Lavinia 1
Description:
Lavinia's blood code. Geared toward magic formae and inflicting status ailments on foes.

Has primarily high Willpower.

Its trait makes it easier to inflict status ailments and overwhelm foes using formae.

Lavinia was born to a branch house of the Superbia Bloodline. She distinguished herself as a central figure in Voda House, and her outstanding ability to control formae was what attracted Progenitor Idris to her. Few are capable of controlling multiple complex formae the way Lavinia can, and she stands unchallenged when it comes to long-term stability and control.

Though large in physique, she is soft-spoken and gentle mannered with an aversion to combat. All of which comes through in the traits of her blood code.

Name: Acedia Bloodline: Jadwiga 1
Description:
Jadwiga's blood code. Suited for magic formae and bayonets.

Has high Dexterity and Willpower.

Supports long-range suppression tactics with its ability to increase the power of magic formae, as well as allowing the use of HP to fire when out of ammo.

The Acedia Bloodline are masters of formae and other revenant techniques. World-renowned innovators and inventors, many have occupied key positions in the worlds of both politics and finance throughout history.

As the name of their bloodline suggests, most from it are given to indolent tendencies. But time spent idly can on occasion be a boon, fostering ingenuity.

Jadwiga's blood code itself is a prime example. Preferring not to bother with direct combat, she has ingeniously perfected it for devastating efficiency from a distance.

Name: Superbia Bloodline: Frantz
Description:
Frantz's blood code. Highly effective with bayonets.

Has a high Dexterity value, but imposes a constant burden.

Its ability to increase the loading capacity of bayonets makes it well-suited for shooting-centric strategies.

Name: Josée the Blind Hero
Description:
The blood code of Josée the Blind Hero. Highly suited to close-quarters combat.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, and Fortitude but imposes a constant burden.

In addition to increasing attack power after dodging, it also increases the attack power of the bequeathed forma, Bloodreaver Blade. It is well-suited to fighting styles focused on counterattacking.

Name: Hero Josée
Description:
The blood code of the hero Josée. Supports a balanced fighting style that incorporates both offense and support.

Has high Strength and Mind, but imposes a constant burden.

It increases the attack power of combat formae. However, it also increases their ichor cost, so judicious use is advised.

Name: One-Armed Hero Lyle
Description:
The blood code of One-Armed Hero Lyle, focused on overwhelming foes with sheer strength.

Has especially high Strength, but imposes a constant burden.

Increases the effectiveness of the bequeathed forma, Absolute Executioner, turning it into a nonstop threat perfect for high-firepower fighting styles.

Name: Hero Lyle
Description:
The blood code of the hero Lyle. It has a learning curve, but also holds much hidden potential.

Has especially high Dexterity, but imposes a constant burden.

In exchange for increased attack power, attacks consume LP. A sound understanding of battle tactics is required to make the most of this blood code.

Name: Pioneer Queen Imogen
Description:
The blood code of Imogen, the Pioneer Queen. Effective for close-quarters combat and making use of status ailments.

Has high Strength and Dexterity, but imposes a constant burden.

This blood code's ability to deal increased damage to foes that are under the effects of a status ailment is the core of its unique strategy.

Name: Hero Holly the Reaper
Description:
The blood code of Hero Holly the Reaper. Produces massive firepower by limiting formae.

Has high Dexterity and Willpower, but imposes a constant burden.

It has the ability to increase overall attack power, but in exchange it decreases the speed of forma use, requiring caution when maneuvering.

Name: Hero Holly
Description:
The blood code of the hero Holly. Specialized in long-ranged attacks, primarily those of magic formae.

Has especially high Willpower, but it imposes a constant burden.

Its ability to increase the attack power of the bequeathed forma MK Rosenritter makes it shine against groups of foes.

Name: Lost Camilo
Description:
The blood code of Camilo after he lost himself. Its specialty is oppressive offense with high balance.

Has high Strength and Vitality, but imposes a constant burden.

Its special ability to increase the balance of charge attacks enables a bold fighting style to force one's way through with high-power attacks.

Name: Hero Zenon
Description:
The blood code of the hero Zenon. It increases stats to a high level and extends the capabilities of support formae.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, Mind, and Vitality, but imposes a constant burden.

Its ability to extend the duration of support formae allows strategies that are dependent upon raising combat ability to a certain level.

Name: Hero Valentin
Description:
The blood code of the hero Valentin. Highly effective at close-range offense and making use of multiple weapons.

Has especially high Strength and Dexterity, but imposes a constant burden.

Burden is reduced when two weapons are equipped. The two weapons and associated formae can unleash a diversity of simultaneous actions. It also has a rare HP recovery trait.

Name: Soul Savior Valentin
Description:
The blood code of Valentin, Savior of Souls. It boasts all-around high-level stats.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower, but imposes a constant burden.

This blood code allows you to ignore bloodline-based equipment limitations, enabling highly expressive, free-form loadouts.

Name: Resurgence Core
Description:
This blood code overwhelms foes through the use of powerful strength and by inflicting unique ailments.

Has especially high Strength, but imposes a constant burden.

Reduces foes' defense when attacks hit. Skilled use of this trait makes its already high damage output go even further.

Name: Guardian's Heart
Description:
An ancient revenant's blood code with high stats in close-quarter combat.

Has high Strength, Dexterity, and Vitality.

As it has no special traits or unique benefits, it does not restrict the type of strategies that can be used, but it can also be seen as somewhat lacking in performance.

Hunters have long made use of Guardian Hearts—jewels fabricated from the hearts of revenants.

Though they allow for the use of powers unbound from a revenant, their effects are limited.

Prior to the Resurgence, before society was transformed and hunters and revenants began working together, all hunters fought using blood codes such as this.
